BETA Close X Drax Group plc has executed a share buyback, purchasing 70,264 ordinary shares on 18 March 2026 at prices ranging from 886.50p to 907.50p, with a volume-weighted average price of 895.2553p. This transaction, part of the programme announced on 31 July 2025, brings the total shares purchased for treasury to 8,273,679. Following this, Drax Group has 432,461,089 ordinary shares in issue, with 95,415,079 held in treasury, resulting in 337,046,010 voting rights. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 19 March 2026 19 March 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 18 March 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 70,264 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 886.5000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 907.5000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 895.2553 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,461,089 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 95,415,079. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 18 March 2026 is 337,046,010. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 8,273,679 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
